source.note: Conservative window allowing annual motion; not a precise LSR transformation. No claim of Doppler agreement until reference frame independently established.

selection.primary_pair: Previously qualified parent ON/OFF URLs, identical grid and UTC epoch; all other dates metadata selected before spectrum read. Alternate same-date scans not independent dates.

measurement.scope: Offline natural astronomic emission validation only. No artificial emitter identification or signal suppression.
measurement.method: Fixed rest-line velocity windows, compare independently median normalized ON/OFF mean spectra at overlapping native channels. Smooth into disjoint 64-bin blocks (about 179 Hz at 2.794 Hz grid); use MAD of all differential block values as descriptive background, report strongest positive block z, number of rows supporting it, and nearby adjacent block support. No calibrated discovery p-values. Do not publish signal fingerprint/model or automatic labels.

gate: Single date is development natural-control candidate only even if both lines meet criteria; independent epoch and accurate velocity-frame confirmation required for scientific confirmation. No automatic protected label or veto. Preserve G4/R28.
